title: Bone Broth Vegetable Pulao

ingredients.item: bone broth, chicken or beef (1½ cups per cup of rice)
salt (less if your broth is salted)

steps: Rinse the rice in several changes of cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then drain well.
Heat the ghee in a heavy pot with a tight-fitting lid over medium heat. Add the cardamom, bay leaves and any other whole spices and toast for 30–60 seconds, until fragrant.
If using, add the cashews and stir until golden, about 1 minute, then add the raisins for 20–30 seconds until they puff. Scoop them out to keep them crunchy for topping, or leave them in.
Add the carrots and mushrooms (and any other veg) and sauté 3–4 minutes, until the mushrooms have released their liquid and started to brown. Stir in the peas.
Add the drained rice and stir gently for 1–2 minutes to coat every grain in the ghee without breaking them.
Pour in the bone broth and add the salt. Taste the liquid; it should be slightly saltier than you'd want to eat. Bring it to a boil.

Turn the heat to the lowest setting, cover tightly and simmer for 12–15 minutes, until the broth is absorbed and small steam holes appear on the surface. If the rice is still firm, sprinkle in 2 tbsp of hot broth or water and give it a few more minutes.
Turn off the heat and leave the lid on for 10 minutes so the rice finishes cooking in its own steam. Don't lift the lid.
Fluff with a fork, fish out the whole spices if you like, and top with the cashews and raisins.
